mapper.select: SELECT MSGID AS msgId, BODYSIZE AS bodySize, BODYHASH AS bodyHash, BODYPATH AS bodyPath, BODYCHARSET AS bodyCharset, BODYTYPE AS bodyType, BODYTEXT AS bodyText, SUBJECT AS subject, SVC AS svc, SRCIP AS srcIp, DSTIP AS dstIp, HOST AS host, PATH AS path, USERID AS userId, NAME AS name, DATE_FORMAT(CTIME,'%Y-%m-%d %H.%i.%S') AS ctime, EPMSG_TYPE AS epmsgType FROM EMS_MESSAGE WHERE MSGID = #{msgId} LIMIT 1
SELECT MSGID AS msgId, BODYHASH AS bodyHash FROM EMS_MESSAGE WHERE MSGID = #{msgId} LIMIT 1
SELECT MSGID AS msgId, TYPE AS type, KEYWORD AS keyword FROM EMS_KEYWORD WHERE MSGID = #{msgId} ORDER BY TYPE, KEYWORD
SELECT MSGID AS msgId, HEADERPATH AS headerPath FROM EMS_MESSAGE WHERE MSGID = #{msgId} LIMIT 1

SELECT A.MSGID AS msgId, A.ATTACHID AS attachId, A.ATTACHNAME AS attachName, A.ATTACHPATH AS attachPath, A.ATTACHSIZE AS attachSize, A.ATTACHEXT AS attachExt, A.ATTACHDESC AS attachDesc, A.ATTACHHASH AS attachHash, A.ENCRYPTED AS encrypted, A.FILTERTYPE AS filterType, A.FLINK AS fLink, A.FLINKKEY AS fLinkKey, B.ATTACHTEXTPATH AS attachTextPath, B.SUMMARY AS summary,
CASE WHEN IFNULL(C.ATTACHHASH, '') = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END ocrYn,
'N' AS ocrYn,
'TRUE' AS consentFlag FROM EMS_ATTACH A LEFT JOIN EMS_ATTACH_HASH B ON A.ATTACHHASH = B.ATTACHHASH
LEFT JOIN EMS_ATTACHTEXT C ON A.ATTACHHASH = C.ATTACHHASH
WHERE 1=1
AND A.MSGID = #{msgId}
AND FIND_IN_SET(A.MSGID, #{msgIds})
AND A.ATTACHID = #{attachId}
ORDER BY A.ATTACHNAME

SELECT MSGID AS msgId, ATTACHID AS attachId, ATTACHNAME AS attachName, ATTACHPATH AS attachPath, ATTACHSIZE AS attachSize, ATTACHEXT AS attachExt, ATTACHDESC AS attachDesc, ATTACHHASH AS attachHash, ENCRYPTED AS encrypted, FILTERTYPE AS filterType, FLINK AS fLink, FLINKKEY AS fLinkKey, SUMMARY AS summary FROM EMS_ATTACH WHERE 1=1
AND FIND_IN_SET(MSGID, #{msgIds})
AND ATTACHHASH = #{attachHash}
AND ATTACHPATH IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ATTACHNAME

SELECT ATTACHTEXTPATH AS attachTextPath, null AS attachTextHarPath, ATTACHSIZE AS attachSize, ATTACHPATH AS attachPath, null AS attachHarPath, ATTACHEXT AS attachExt FROM EMS_ATTACH_HASH WHERE ATTACHHASH = #{attachHash} LIMIT 1

SELECT A.ATTACHHASH, A.ATTACHNAME AS attachName, B.ATTACHTEXTPATH AS attachTextPath, B.ATTACHSIZE AS attachSize, B.ATTACHPATH AS attachPath, B.ATTACHEXT AS attachExt, C.`TEXT` AS attachText FROM EMS_ATTACH_HASH B, EMS_ATTACH A LEFT JOIN EMS_ATTACHTEXT C ON ( A.ATTACHHASH = C.ATTACHHASH ) WHERE A.MSGID = #{msgId} AND A.ATTACHID = #{attachId} AND A.ATTACHHASH = B.ATTACHHASH LIMIT 1
SELECT TYPE AS type, ATTACHNAME AS attachName, PI_ID AS piid, AMOUNT AS total FROM EMS_PI WHERE MSGID = #{msgId} ORDER BY ( CASE TYPE WHEN 'A' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 WHEN 'S' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END )
mapper.update: REPLACE INTO UI_ADMIN_XROOTMTR SET ADMIN_ID = #{adminId}, XROOTMTR = #{xRootMtr}, MSGID = #{msgId}, SRCIP = #{srcip}
REPLACE INTO UI_ADMIN_USERID_GENERATIVE SET ADMIN_ID = #{adminId}, userid = #{userid}, MSGID = #{msgId}, SRCIP = #{srcip},TYPE = #{type}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(MAX(DOWN_SEQ), 0) + 1 AS downSeq FROM UI_DOWNLOAD_BATCH
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_DOWNLOAD_BATCH (DOWN_SEQ, EXPORT_TYPE, EXPORT_FILE_EXT, DOWN_VAL, ADMIN_ID, REQ_DT, END_DT, DOWN_STATUS, STATUS_STR, DOWNFILE_PATH, DOWNFILE_SIZE, TOTAL_ROWS, ING_ROWS, SKIP_ROWS, UPDATE_DT) VALUES (#{downSeq}, #{exportType}, #{exportFileExt}, #{downVal}, #{adminId}, NOW(), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL + 3 DAY), #{downStatus}, #{statusStr}, #{downFilePath}, 0, #{totalRows}, 0, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE UI_DOWNLOAD_BATCH SET STATUS_STR = #{val}, UPDATE_DT = NOW() WHERE STATUS_STR IN ('S', 'I')
UPDATE UI_DOWNLOAD_BATCH SET STATUS_STR = #{statuSel}, UPDATE_DT = NOW() WHERE DOWN_SEQ = #{downSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT DOWN_SEQ AS downSeq , EXPORT_TYPE AS exportType , EXPORT_FILE_EXT AS exportFileExt , DOWN_VAL AS downVal , ADMIN_ID AS adminId , REQ_DT AS reqDt , END_DT AS endDt , DOWN_STATUS AS downStatus , DOWNFILE_PATH AS downFilePath , STATUS_STR AS statusStr FROM UI_DOWNLOAD_BATCH WHERE DATE_FORMAT(END_DT, '%Y%m%d') < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') AND STATUS_STR = 'Y'

SELECT DOWN_SEQ AS downSeq, DOWN_VAL AS downVal, EXPORT_TYPE AS exportType, EXPORT_FILE_EXT AS exportFileExt, ADMIN_ID AS adminId, DATE_FORMAT(REQ_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') AS reqDt, DATE_FORMAT(END_DT,'%Y-%m-%d') AS endDt, DOWN_STATUS AS downStatus, STATUS_STR AS statusStr, DOWNFILE_PATH AS downFilePath, DOWNFILE_SIZE AS downFileSize, ING_ROWS AS ingRows, TOTAL_ROWS AS totalRows FROM UI_DOWNLOAD_BATCH WHERE STATUS_STR IN ('S', 'I') AND UPDATE_DT < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{delay} HOUR) ORDER BY REQ_DT DESC

SELECT SEARCH_KEYWORD AS searchKeyword FROM UI_SEARCH_KEYWORD WHERE UPPER( TRIM(SEARCH_KEYWORD) ) LIKE UPPER( CONCAT('%', TRIM( #{searchKeyword} ), '%' ) ) AND ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} ORDER BY CREATE_DT DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT SK_SEQ AS skSeq, SEARCH_KEYWORD AS searchKeyword, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') AS createDt FROM UI_SEARCH_KEYWORD WHERE 1 = 1
AND UPPER( TRIM(SEARCH_KEYWORD) ) LIKE UPPER( CONCAT('%', TRIM( #{searchKeyword} ), '%' ) )
AND ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} ORDER BY CREATE_DT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_SEARCH_KEYWORD(ADMIN_ID, SEARCH_KEYWORD, CREATE_DT) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{searchKeyword}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT CODE AS code, NAME AS name, REGEX AS regex FROM UI_REGEXP
WHERE ( CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') OR NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') )
ORDER BY name
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(DOWN_SEQ), 0) + 1 AS downSeq FROM UI_DOWNLOAD_BATCH_MESSENGER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_DOWNLOAD_BATCH_MESSENGER (DOWN_SEQ, DOWN_VAL, ADMIN_ID, REQ_DT, END_DT, DOWN_STATUS, STATUS_STR, DOWNFILE_PATH, DOWNFILE_SIZE) VALUES (#{downSeq},#{downVal}, #{adminId}, NOW(), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL + 3 DAY), #{downStatus}, #{statusStr}, #{downFilePath}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT DOWN_SEQ AS downSeq , DOWN_VAL AS downVal , ADMIN_ID AS adminId , REQ_DT AS reqDt , END_DT AS endDt , DOWN_STATUS AS downStatus , DOWNFILE_PATH AS downFilePath , STATUS_STR AS statusStr FROM UI_DOWNLOAD_BATCH_MESSENGER WHERE DATE_FORMAT(END_DT, '%Y%m%d') < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') AND STATUS_STR = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_CHRONY (CHRONY_STATUS, CHRONY_SERVER,CORNY_DATATIME ) VALUES (#{status}, #{ntpServer}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT CHRONY_STATUS AS status, CHRONY_SERVER AS ntpServer, CORNY_DATATIME AS dateTime FROM UI_CHRONY ORDER BY CORNY_DATATIME DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM UI_CHRONY WHERE CORNY_DATATIME < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
